scope: normal DeepSeek producer through existing server family hooks

sampler.history: prompt original IDs plus sampled generated IDs of current request
sampler.logprobs: adjusted logits before temperature and truncation
sampler.sampling: effective temperature -> top_k -> relative-max min_p -> top_p -> CDF

metadata.record: LEu32 rawID + u8 LPpresence + optional(LEf32 selected + LEu32 alternatives + repeated LEu32 ID/LEf32 LP)
metadata.finish: LEu32 origin ascii byte count + origin bytes
